# period part of

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:periodPartOf`](gmeow-periodPartOf.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/periodPartOf>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/temporal`](../../slices/temporal.md)

Relates a named period to a larger named period that contains it (e.g. Holocene ⊂ Quaternary ⊂ Cenozoic). Transitive.

## Structure

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:NamedPeriod`](../classes/gmeow-NamedPeriod.md) -> [`gmeow:NamedPeriod`](../classes/gmeow-NamedPeriod.md)
